column1: # One row per class named *Module.java in the venom4plugin 0.3.0 archive.
# Columns: file, kind, disposition, reference, registered, detail.
# kind: module (registered by Meteor) or base (abstract, never registered).
# disposition: ported | merged | check | catalogue | excluded | base.
# reference: the ExploitCatalog entry the disposition names, or empty.
# registered: yes when Venom4Plugin.onInitialize added it to Meteor, else no.
